capabilities: Hide individual UI elements (sidebars, toolbars, tab bars, padding) with one toggle each
Run a zenmode toggle that goes fullscreen with only the note showing
Choose which tabs the sidebar opens with, including a daily note button
Adjust file explorer spacing and editor scroll offset
Show a git status, pull and push sidebar tab through the Git plugin
extras: Also installable via BRAT (merlinkraemer/obsidian-zen). Disclosures state the plugin runs no shell commands and makes no network requests, and that git operations go entirely through the Git plugin.
problem: Obsidian shows sidebars, toolbars, tab bars and padding that some writers want out of the way while focusing on a single note.

relations.evidence: Pull, push, commit and fetch go through the Git plugin.

summary: Interface declutter plugin that toggles individual Obsidian UI elements on and off and adds a fullscreen zen mode.
